entries.1aa5dfd69ef819ae: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells "preforms," the base material of PET bottles, and plastic caps, and also provides related services. It is handled by ALTECH Shin-Zairyo Co., Ltd. (Sakai, Fukui Prefecture) and consolidated subsidiaries in Suzhou, Guangzhou, Chongqing and Wuhan in China. Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥8,618 million (down 9.5% from the previous year), and the segment loss was ¥523 million (compared with a loss of ¥530 million in the previous year). Net sales include internal transactions between segments. The securities report states that the decrease in sales was due to lower sales volume of beverage preforms and lower sales of recycled flake material. The company withdrew from the recycled flake business during this fiscal year.

entries.95f99331beb5606f: Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥17,551 million (down 3.7% from the previous year). Net sales were ¥9,006 million (up 2.8%) for the Trading Business and ¥8,618 million (down 9.5%) for the Preform Business; both amounts include internal transactions between segments. The Annual Securities Report states that the decline in Preform Business revenue was due to lower sales volume of beverage preforms and lower sales of recycled flake material. As of November 30, 2025, the order backlog of the Trading Business was down 34.0% from the previous year.

entries.a2489b41341d9a81: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥24 million (operating loss of ¥148 million in the previous year). Due to the recording of a provision for doubtful accounts as a non-operating expense and other factors, ordinary loss was ¥126 million (ordinary loss of ¥253 million in the previous year), and net loss attributable to owners of parent was ¥2,594 million (net loss of ¥98 million in the previous year). The Annual Securities Report states that this was due, among other things, to recording restructuring costs of the recycled flake business and impairment write-downs for some consolidated subsidiaries as extraordinary losses. Segment income (loss) was a profit of ¥768 million for the Trading Business and a loss of ¥523 million for the Preform Business.

entries.c575865abe5f2a5a: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the Group (the company and 12 subsidiaries) operates two reportable segments: the Trading Business, which purchases and sells industrial machinery and equipment and related services, and the Preform Business, which manufactures and sells PET bottle preforms and plastic caps. The Trading Business purchases and sells machinery and equipment in fields such as printing and packaging, food, medical, batteries and semiconductors. The Preform Business manufactures at four bases in Fukui Prefecture in Japan and in China and sells mainly to major customers. Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥17,551 million (down 3.7% year on year).

entries.fb136f5f7c844407: A reportable segment that purchases and sells industrial machinery and equipment and also provides services such as maintenance. It has the largest sales to external customers of the 2 reportable segments. The company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam are in charge. In the fiscal year ended November 2025, revenue was ¥9,006 million (up 2.8% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥768 million (up 22.2% from the previous year). Revenue is the amount including internal transactions between segments. The securities report states that although there was a reactionary decline from the next-generation hybrid conference system, which performed well in the previous year, the completion of acceptance inspection of large machinery such as tube manufacturing machines, food processing machinery and water treatment equipment, and the delivery of the small electric bus "e-JEST" to Minamiboso City, Chiba Prefecture, led to higher revenue.
